use default

let small_primes = LIST()
let sieve_limit = 1_000

let marked = LIST()

for _ in 0::sieve_limit do
    marked.add(false)
od

for candidate in 2::sieve_limit do
    if !marked[candidate] then
        small_primes.add(candidate)

        let multiple mut = candidate * candidate

        while multiple <= sieve_limit do
            marked[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi
od

probably_prime(value: long) -> bool is
    for small in small_primes do
        let divisor = cast long(small)

        if value == divisor then return true fi
        if value % divisor == 0L then return false fi
    od

    let subject = bigint(value)
    let one = 1n
    let two = 2n

    let odd_part mut = subject - one
    let power mut = 0

    while (odd_part % two).is_zero do
        odd_part = odd_part / two
        power = power + 1
    od

    for base in [2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13] do
        let residue mut =
            bigint.mod_pow(bigint(base), odd_part, subject)
        let witnessed mut = residue =~ one \/ residue =~ subject - one

        for _ in 1..power do
            if witnessed then break fi

            residue = residue * residue % subject
            witnessed = residue =~ subject - one
        od

        if !witnessed then return false fi
    od

    true
si

cubans() -> Pipe[long] is
    let n mut = 0L

    do
        n = n + 1L

        let candidate = 3L * n * n + 3L * n + 1L

        if probably_prime(candidate) then
            yield candidate
        fi
    od
si

write_line("the first 200 cuban primes:")

let first = cubans() |> take(200) |> map(p => "{p,12:N0}") |> collect_list()

for row in 0..25 do
    write_line(first[row * 8..row * 8 + 8] |> join(""))
od

let hundred_thousandth =
    for entry in cubans() |> index() do
        if entry.index == 99_999 then break entry.value fi
    od

let largest = hundred_thousandth!

write_line("")
write_line("the 100,000th cuban prime is {largest:N0}")
